## 2. Founder Background & Mission
- **Founder:** Courtney Miller
- **Role:** Founder & Community Leader
- **Background:** A passionate pharmacy technician with over three decades (30+ years) of direct, hands-on clinical and operations experience spanning community/retail pharmacy, long-term care (LTC), correctional health facilities, and hospital specialized pharmacy environments.
- **Mission:** Being a pharmacy technician is often challenging, high-stress, and professionally isolated. Pharm Techs Only! was founded to empower, unite, advocate for, and provide free professional resources to pharmacy technicians worldwide so they can advance their careers, earn competitive compensation, and connect with peers.

## 3. TechConnect™ Community Platform
- **URL:** https://tc.pharmtechsonly.com
- **Description:** TechConnect™ is the proprietary, ad-free professional social networking platform created specifically for pharmacy technicians.
- **Features:**
  - Specialized topic-based communities (Hospital Practice, Retail Pharmacy, IV Compounding, PTCB Exam Prep, Career Changers).
  - Real-time chat, discussion forums, and peer-to-peer messaging.
  - Interactive industry polls and salary surveys.
  - Direct employer job connections and career networking.
  - Free account registration for all pharmacy technicians.

## 4. Free CEU Directory (Continuing Education Units)
- **URL:** https://www.pharmtechsonly.com/resource-center/free-ceus
- **Purpose:** Help pharmacy technicians fulfill state licensing and national certification renewal requirements completely free of charge.
- **Accreditation:** All listed courses are ACPE-accredited (Accreditation Council for Pharmacy Education) or recognized by PTCB (Pharmacy Technician Certification Board) and NHA (National Healthcareer Association).
- **Providers Featured:** Pharmacy Times, PowerPak, University of Connecticut School of Pharmacy (UConn), American Society of Health-System Pharmacists (ASHP), FreeCE, and other accredited healthcare education institutions.
- **Topics Covered:**
  - Pharmacy Law & Regulatory Compliance (meets mandatory 1-hour renewal requirement).
  - Patient Safety & Medication Error Prevention (meets mandatory 1-hour renewal requirement).
  - Immunization Administration & Vaccine Updates (HPV, RSV, COVID-19, Influenza).
  - Diabetes Technology & Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) Management.
  - Sterile and Non-Sterile Compounding (USP <797>, USP <795>, USP <800> hazardous drugs).
  - Specialty Pharmacy, Oncology, and Novel Therapeutics.
  - Adolescent HIV Prophylaxis, Opioid Stewardship, and Mental Health.
- **Expiration Policy:** Courses are continuously monitored and expired courses are promptly removed. Course hours range from 0.5 to 2.0+ contact hours each.

## 5. Certification & License Renewal Standards
- **PTCB (Pharmacy Technician Certification Board) Requirements:**
  - Recertification cycle: Every 2 years.
  - Required CE hours: Minimum 20 hours of pharmacy-related continuing education.
  - Mandatory subjects: At least 1 hour of Pharmacy Law and at least 1 hour of Patient Safety.
  - Maximum non-accredited/employer hours: Up to 5 hours subject to audit.
- **NHA (National Healthcareer Association - ExCPT) Requirements:**
  - Recertification cycle: Every 2 years.
  - Required CE hours: Minimum 20 hours.
  - Mandatory subjects: Minimum 1 hour of Pharmacy Law and 1 hour of Patient Safety.
- **State Board Requirements:**
  - State requirements vary widely, ranging between 20 and 40 continuing education hours every 2 years. Technicians should verify requirements with their state's Board of Pharmacy.

## 6. Career Tools & Downloadable Guides
- **URL:** https://www.pharmtechsonly.com/resource-center/careers
- **Available Toolkits (Free PDF Downloads):**
  1. **LinkedIn Profile Makeover:** Step-by-step instructions on headlines, experience descriptions, skills tagging, and recruiter visibility tailored for pharmacy technicians.
  2. **Pharmacy Technician Resume Tips:** High-impact formatting, clinical skill bullet points, quantification of dispensing volume, and applicant tracking system (ATS) optimization.
  3. **Cover Letter Templates:** Persuasive, professionally drafted templates for community, hospital, and non-traditional technician positions.
  4. **Nail Your Job Interview:** Common behavioral questions, STAR method interview examples, situational clinical scenarios, and questions to ask prospective employers.
  5. **Career Pivot Guide:** Transitioning from pharmacy technician skills into healthcare IT (Epic Willow, Cerner), pharmaceutical sales, PBM prior authorizations, and compliance analysis.
  6. **Protect Your Mental Health:** Burnout mitigation strategies, boundary setting in high-volume retail environments, and stress resilience.

## 10. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What is Pharm Techs Only!?
Pharm Techs Only! (PTO!) is the premier global online platform and professional community created exclusively for pharmacy technicians. Founded by a 30+ year pharmacy technician, PTO! provides free accredited CEUs, career resources, association directories, conference calendars, employer tools, and the TechConnect™ social platform.

### Is Pharm Techs Only! free for pharmacy technicians?
Yes, access to all educational resources, the Free CEU directory, downloadable career guides, and registration on the TechConnect™ community platform is 100% free for all pharmacy technicians.

### Are the CEU courses on Pharm Techs Only! accredited?
Yes. All courses listed in the Free CEU directory are accredited by the Accreditation Council for Pharmacy Education (ACPE) or recognized by PTCB and NHA for national recertification and state license renewal.

### How do pharmacy technicians earn CEUs on the platform?
PTO! curates direct links to accredited course providers. Technicians click through to the course, complete the free learning module and evaluation, and receive their ACPE statement of credit or certificate directly through CPE Monitor or the provider.

### How can employers advertise job openings on PTO!?
Employers can purchase a Job Boost package ($49.95) to feature their open pharmacy technician positions across PTO!'s 26,000+ member social channels and TechConnect community, or email questions@pharmtechsonly.com for employer recruitment programs.
